# React Native ReactCommon for HarmonyOS

if(NOT DEFINED RNH_REACT_COMMON_DIR)
    set(RNH_REACT_COMMON_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ReactCommon")
endif()

set(REACT_COMMON_DIR ${RNH_REACT_COMMON_DIR} CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(REACT_COMMON_PATCH_DIR "${patches_dir}/react_native_core")

# Include patches
include_directories(${REACT_COMMON_PATCH_DIR})

# Dummy targets for ReactCommon CMakeLists compatibility
add_library(boost INTERFACE)
add_library(folly_runtime ALIAS folly)
add_library(log INTERFACE)
add_library(glog_init INTERFACE)

# ReactCommon subdirectories
